nonBlockingObservations.observation: The conformed row names a collision with another component's live name as not a root-command claim, and it says a manifest the security owner's manifest admission refuses first keeps that route. M3-D r5 item 24 (PROPOSAL-r5.md:787) also names an in-tree name, alias or parent collision as not EE-5a, on the security owner's route. The row's predicate is exactly (a), (b) and (c), and (b) is the security owner's MULTIPLE_ROOT_COMMANDS refusal before R10a. A later record can name the in-tree collision beside the live-name collision.
